fixed.summary: Natively the tick a streaming group becomes resident (and its StreamEvent) follows from ticks alone: at most one group is put in place per tick, and a frame that catches up runs a boundary per tick. It moved with the host's calls (one group per probe call, idle frame or catch-up frame), so og run and og run --json reached different hashes. Runs that called the probe between frames now see the plain run's ticks. On the web a pack's arrival stays host timing; the world guide §4 says how to wait deterministically.
